tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand ink. The wordmark, headlines and body text on paper, oat, mist and sage. Fixed in both themes: logos always use it.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Secondary brand green. Muted text on paper (5.5:1), oat (5.0:1) and mist (4.6:1). Never on forest.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Signature color-block field. Big sage blocks behind forest text (6.1:1). Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Pale sage tint: callout and card fields behind forest or moss text.

tokens.name: oat
tokens.usage: Warm cream ground and the reversed ink on forest (10.5:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Lightest ground: the blog page itself. Forest text 11.5:1.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The one accent: the N in the wordmark, the Talk Drop, primary buttons, focus. Text on paper 5.2:1 and oat 4.7:1; paper text on a clay fill 5.2:1. One clay moment per view.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light = paper, dark = deep forest.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the header bar, raised panels. Light = oat, dark = forest.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Soft fields: callouts, the routine-step rail, quiet tags.

tokens.name: surface-block
tokens.usage: Bold color blocks (hero bands, feature panels). Sage in both themes; text on it is on-block.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint. Worst pair: 9.5:1 light (on tint), 9.2:1 dark (on tint).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, secondary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint. Worst pair: 4.6:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-block
tokens.usage: Text and marks on surface-block (sage): 6.1:1 light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay. Primary action fill, the one highlighted word, link underline. As text: on surface and surface-raised only (light 5.2:1 / 4.7:1, dark 6.9:1 / 5.4:1); never as text on surface-tint in light (4.3:1) or on surface-block.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label text on an accent fill (primary button): 5.2:1 light, 6.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers only (decorative). Never the only border on a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and the 2px graphic rules: meets 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px accent outline, 2px offset. 5.2:1 on paper, 6.9:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text; underline in accent (2px, 3px offset).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: hero headline, book cover, poster. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, step numbers, buttons' small caps. Always uppercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Short version: most people need three things. Here they are.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of an article: the straight answer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Niacinamide (a form of vitamin B3) calms redness and helps your skin barrier. It plays well with almost everything.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The verdict line inside body copy. Once or twice per article.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Updated for 2026. Tested on combination skin.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph-to-heading.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between article sections.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Color blocks and full-bleed bands: hard edges keep it graphic.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and callouts, with the bottom-left corner at radius-0 (the talk corner).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips, with the bottom-left corner at radius-0 (the talk corner).

border.note: Graphic rules, not shadows. SCNSK is flat.

tokens.usage: Dividers in line color.
